billingSemantics.api: OpenAI usage semantics: prompt_tokens includes cached_tokens (usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens). costUsd = (inputTokens - cachedTokens) * inputPerMTok + cachedTokens * cachedInputPerMTok + outputTokens * outputPerMTok.
billingSemantics.dsh: dsh session-log usage semantics: totalTokens = inputTokens + outputTokens + cachedTokens (cached is a separate bucket, never part of inputTokens). costUsd = inputTokens * inputPerMTok + cachedTokens * cachedInputPerMTok + outputTokens * outputPerMTok.
billingSemantics.envOverride: POLARIS_CLH_<TIER>_PRICE_CACHED_PER_MTOK overrides the catalog cached rate; when an env override sets only input/output prices, cached reads bill at the input rate (conservative over-estimate, never under-bills).
billingSemantics.resolution: Pricing resolution (PRD 3.14.8): env override > catalog entry (longest prefix match, case-sensitive) > unresolvable. An unresolvable model makes a budget-declaring run fail closed with CLH_PRICING_UNRESOLVED before the first step; without a declared budget costUsd stays honestly undefined.

entries.note: Peak rates (conservative). Off-peak is half: cache-hit $0.003, cache-miss $0.15, output $0.6 per MTok. Peak hours 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Monday-Friday. Model version DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, API name deepseek-flash.
Listed separately from GLM-5.3-Flash so the Flash prefix cannot misprice FlashX (longest prefix match).
Cached input storage is limited-time free and not billed.
Singapore international standard price, 0 < tokens <= 256K tier. The model is not in the Model Studio context-cache program, so cached reads bill at the standard input price.
